ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened largely flat with modest gains across major assets, led by a 4.7% jump in XRP. ETF inflows of $1.7 bn in two days buoyed Bitcoin, while BitMEX’s exit from trading may tighten liquidity. Attention turns to regulatory and technical developments such as the XRP Ledger upgrade and Coinbase’s new USDC‑backed borrowing feature.
